definition.def: If you encounter problems or difficulties, you experience them.
examples: Every day of our lives we encounter stresses of one kind or another. [VERB noun]
Thousands of customers have encountered problems. [VERB noun]

definition.def: If you encounter someone, you meet them, usually unexpectedly. [formal]
examples: Did you encounter anyone in the building? [VERB noun]
Renata wrote him that she had encountered her long-estranged father. [VERB noun]

definition.def: An encounter with someone is a meeting with them, particularly one that is unexpected or significant.
examples: ...offering supporters the chance to win an encounter with the President in return for any size of donation. [+ with]

definition.def: An encounter is a particular type of experience.
examples: She was not the only person to feel daunted by her encounter with the court. [+ with]
